topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Workforce use rules in POL-02 Part C and the sanctions rule in A.4 (approved 2026-08-31); before that, only the employee handbook
gap: No signed acknowledgments yet
remediation: Walk through POL-02 to POL-04 at a staff meeting and collect signed acknowledgments from all 7 employees

control_description: The Owner reviews the POA&M, the account list, and the recipe change log at a monthly 30-minute meeting (POL-02 A.2), starting 2026-09
gap: Oversight just started; no record yet
remediation: Keep notes of each monthly meeting

control_description: Security Coordinator (Office Manager) and batch control system owner (Operations Manager) designated in writing (POL-02 A.1); MSP duties in its contract
gap: No one owns patching and antivirus on the HMI PC: the MSP treats it as the integrator's machine and the integrator treats it as the company's (P04)
remediation: Name one owner for each HMI control in both contracts (POAM-013)

control_description: DOT hazmat training for 6 hazmat employees every 3 years, including security awareness (49 CFR 172.704)
gap: No cyber awareness training; the operator hired 2026-04-20 missed the DOT 90-day deadline (trained 2026-08-14)
remediation: Yearly cyber training, phishing simulations, and new-hire training on the onboarding checklist (POAM-010)

control_description: Sanctions rule in POL-02 A.4
gap: Not yet applied; no sanction records
remediation: Record sanctions when applied

control_description: None: no inventory of devices, OT components, SaaS services, or data locations, and no network diagram
gap: No inventory or network diagram
remediation: One-page inventory including the PLC, HMI PC, gateway, and SaaS services, and a network diagram kept with the SSP

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved and stored in the shared drive
gap: Policies not yet communicated; reporting rule card not posted
remediation: Staff walkthrough; reporting cards at every workstation and the HMI (POAM-012)

control_description: Supply agreements and SDSs for customers; SDS updates emailed to the ERI provider
gap: No security contact named for customers; the distributor's questionnaire is unanswered; the ERI provider does not confirm SDS updates
remediation: Send this summary to the distributor and name the Office Manager as security contact; ERI provider confirms each SDS update (R-012)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk tolerance and acceptance authority defined
2026 risk assessment with NIST SP 800-30 (23 risks, including the batch control system and key vendors)
Fraud risk assessed in the risk register: payment redirection by business email compromise (R-008) and theft or diversion of hydrogen peroxide (R-015)
Major changes that trigger a risk review are listed in P01 section 5 and POL-02 A.2
gap: No way to learn of changes vendors make: the integrator switched on the AI feature in May 2026 without telling the company
remediation: Vendor change notice in the integrator and MSP terms (POAM-013); new-feature check in POL-04

control_description: Independent control assessment 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-12 by an OT-experienced consultant
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reviewed monthly with the Owner

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP from the Moderate baseline, tailored for OT
gap: 16 of 44 controls still planned
remediation: Complete the POA&M

control_description: MSP runs office technology controls under contract; the integrator supports the PLC and HMI
evidence: MSP contract; monthly MSP report; integrator service agreement
gap: No technology controls on the HMI PC; no oversight of integrator work
remediation: Quarterly advisory report from the integrator; allowlisting on the HMI (POAM-007, POAM-008)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Three policies approved (POL-02, POL-03, POL-04)
gap: Checklists, the contingency plan, and the restore procedure not yet written
remediation: Onboarding and termination checklist; contingency plan with the hurricane checklist

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: MFA on the productivity suite for all users; MFA on the accounting service for the Owner only
evidence: Suite and accounting MFA settings; P07 test
gap: Shared portal login without MFA reaches the PLC and HMI; shared HMI operator login; MFA missing for 3 of 4 accounting users and on MSP-held logins
remediation: Named portal accounts with MFA; MFA everywhere in POL-02 B.3; named HMI logins (POAM-001, POAM-002, POAM-003)

control_description: Office Manager grants SaaS access on request
gap: No approval record or onboarding checklist
remediation: Onboarding checklist with written approval (POL-02 B.4; POAM-003)

control_description: Operators run batches; the Operations Manager edits recipes (by practice, not enforced)
gap: Former bookkeeper's accounting login active about 4 months; shared HMI login holds engineering rights; HMI password and door code unchanged after a departure
remediation: Termination checklist; monthly reconciliation; named HMI roles (POAM-003, POAM-011)

control_description: Keypad entry, locked raw-material room for the peroxide totes, alarm with cellular communicator, 4 cameras; SaaS data centers covered by vendor reports
gap: Shared door code not changed after the operator left on 2026-03-13; camera video not reviewed
remediation: Change the door code now and at every departure; weekly tote count (R-015)

control_description: MSP wipes laptops before reuse
gap: No disposal record; no plan for wiping the HMI PC when it is replaced in 2027
remediation: Disposal record for every device, including the HMI PC (POL-04)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: MSP firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic; MFA on the suite
gap: Always-on cellular gateway outside the firewall; HMI PC on the flat office network; guest Wi-Fi reached the HMI remote desktop service in testing
remediation: Gateway off except watched sessions; guest Wi-Fi separated; HMI segment (POAM-001, POAM-006)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all SaaS services; laptops encrypted
gap: Formulations folder shared by an 'anyone with the link' link; recipe files moved between the HMI and office on unscanned USB sticks
remediation: Named guest account for the private-label folder (R-009); one scanned company USB stick (POL-02 B.10)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: MSP antivirus on office computers
gap: No protection on the HMI PC; USB sticks enter it unscanned; alerts after hours are missed
remediation: Allowlisting on the HMI PC; scanned USB stick; after-hours alert routing (POAM-008)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: MSP patches office computers monthly
gap: HMI PC out of mainstream support and unpatched since 2023; no one tracks PLC or gateway advisories
remediation: Quarterly advisory report; supported HMI PC at the 2027 year-end shutdown (POAM-007)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: None beyond antivirus alerts
gap: Portal session log, firewall logs, and SaaS sign-in logs are not reviewed; HMI audit trail off
remediation: Portal session alerts (POAM-001); session log and sign-in review at the monthly meeting; HMI audit trail (POAM-009)

control_description: Incident log required by POL-03 4.3 from 2026-09-01
gap: No incident records before 2026-09; 3 of 5 staff would restart the HMI before reporting
remediation: Start the incident log; reporting cards (POAM-012)

control_description: Runbook for an intrusion into the batch control system, with the MSP, integrator, and insurer in the chain
gap: Not tested
remediation: Tabletop with the MSP and integrator (POAM-012)

control_description: Integrator's 2023 copy of the PLC program; monthly recipe export to USB; daily suite backup
evidence: Integrator statement; MSP backup job report
gap: No tested way to restore the HMI, PLC program, or recipes; realistic recovery 1 to 2 weeks against a 24-hour RTO (P05)
remediation: Offline backup with checksums; restore test on the spare panel PC (POAM-004, POAM-005)

control_description: Owner's written approval on the batch ticket for recipe and alarm limit changes from 2026-09-01 (POL-02 A.11)
gap: Before 2026-09-01 no change was reviewed, approved, or logged; 2 of 10 sampled batch tickets did not match the HMI recipe
remediation: Integrator change notes; HMI audit trail and change log review (POAM-009)

control_description: BIA completed; cyber liability insurance with a breach hotline; finished goods cover about 3 days
gap: No contingency plan; one internet line (risk accepted, R-020)
remediation: Contingency plan with the hurricane checklist (POAM-005)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Accounting vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report reviewed 2026-08-19
gap: No security terms with the integrator or MSP; other SaaS vendors not reviewed
remediation: Security terms at renewal; yearly vendor review (POAM-013)

control_description: SaaS capacity managed by vendors; one business internet line; small UPS on the PLC and HMI
gap: Single internet line with no failover (accepted by the Owner, R-020); no generator
remediation: Paper shipping procedure; reconsider failover at the 2027 review

control_description: Accounting vendor replication; daily suite backup with 30 days of versions
evidence: Accounting vendor SOC 2; MSP backup job report
gap: The plant (PLC program, HMI project, recipes) is not backed up; suite backup not immutable
remediation: Weekly offline export; 90 days of immutable versions (POAM-004)

control_description: None
gap: No restore or recovery testing
remediation: Restore tests and a yearly tabletop (POAM-005)
